# wso2is_federated_authenticator_metadata (Data Source)

Describes the properties that a federated authenticator or an outbound provisioning connector accepts. Use it when you write a `wso2is_identity_provider` configuration. Put confidential properties in `secret_properties`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_federated_authenticator_metadata" "google" {
  name = "GoogleOIDCAuthenticator"
}

output "google_properties" {
  value = { for p in data.wso2is_federated_authenticator_metadata.google.properties : p.key => p.mandatory }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Authenticator or connector name, for example `GoogleOIDCAuthenticator` or `SCIM2`.

### Optional

- `kind` (String) `federated-authenticators` (default) or `outbound-provisioning-connectors`.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) API ID.
- `properties` (Attributes List) Accepted properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Read-Only:

- `confidential` (Boolean) Whether it is a secret.
- `default_value` (String) Default value.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `key` (String) Property key.
- `mandatory` (Boolean) Whether it is required.
- `options` (List of String) Allowed values.
- `type` (String) `STRING`, `BOOLEAN`, ...
